misconfig_patterns: Envoy Gateway exposed on port 80 LoadBalancer without auth proxy (quickstart shows raw curl http://${ENDPOINT}/v1/completions)
aibrix-runtime sidecar on 8080 exposes /healthz and /ready unauthenticated, plus model management surface
routing-strategy header (random|least-load|pd) trusted from client — bypasses any router algorithm choice
Per-model HTTPRoute auto-created in aibrix-system namespace — model name from header IS the routing key, no allowlist
vLLM backend on 8000 reachable directly if Service is LoadBalancer instead of ClusterIP
INFERENCE_ENGINE_ENDPOINT env on runtime sidecar = http://localhost:8000 — runtime can be coerced into proxying internal vLLM

secondary_probe.discriminator: AIBrix returns Envoy 404 with no-route when routing-strategy header set but no model header matches — pattern unique to aibrix gateway patch

active_probe.false_positive_check: INFERRED: combine /v1/models response (vLLM-style) with presence of routing-strategy / target-pod headers being honored. Bare /v1/models can be vLLM directly; AIBrix tell is the gateway layer reacting to routing-strategy header.

deployment_tells: Namespace tell: aibrix-system contains aibrix-controller-manager, aibrix-gateway-plugins, aibrix-gpu-optimizer, aibrix-kuberay-operator, aibrix-metadata-service, aibrix-redis-master
K8s label model.aibrix.ai/name on Deployment + Service
K8s annotation model.aibrix.ai/sidecar-injection: true triggers aibrix-runtime sidecar
Docker image aibrix/runtime:v0.5.0+ alongside vllm/vllm-openai container
HTTPRoute resources named <model>-router in aibrix-system namespace
target-pod header maps to ORIGINAL_DST cluster — direct pod targeting
Quickstart endpoint format: ${LB_IP}:80 with no auth
pivot_paths: GET / on port 80 with no host -> Envoy default 404 + 'no healthy upstream' if no model header set
GET /v1/models -> model list from gateway aggregator -> enumerates every Deployment labeled model.aibrix.ai/name
POST /v1/chat/completions with model name from /v1/models -> direct vLLM access via gateway with no API key (unless --api-key set on backend)
GET /metrics on backend port 8000 -> vllm: prefixed Prometheus -> infer cluster GPU count and current request rate
GET /healthz and /ready on runtime sidecar port 8080 -> confirms aibrix-runtime presence (LiveProbe/ReadyProbe paths from base-api-key.yaml)
kubectl-style HTTPRoute enumeration via gateway: model header value = backend Service name in default namespace
Redis dependency (aibrix-redis-master) — INFERRED: if reachable, holds rate-limiter state and gateway plugin cache
